children: RNS Number : 9851X  Morgan Sindall Group PLC  07 October 2026

The Company announces that it issued and allotted 160,913 Ordinary Shares of 5p each ("New Ordinary Shares") for the purpose of satisfying options granted under the rules of the Morgan Sindall Sharesave Plan (2018). The New Ordinary Shares were admitted to trading under existing block admissions.
This notification is made under PRM 1.6.4 and covers the period 11 August 2026 to 6 October 2026. The table below provides further details.
Name, type and ISIN of the securities
Number of further securities admitted to trading covered by this notification
160,913 Ordinary shares to satisfy options granted under the Morgan Sindall Sharesave Plan (2018).
Total number of securities admitted to trading following further issuance
Fully fungible with existing Ordinary shares
Date of issuance and admission to trading
Issued on various dates between 11 August 2026 and 6 October 2026.
